g.text: cartId: "c-100", customerId: "cust-7", items: [{ sku: "sku-1", qty: 1, unitPrice: 75.00 }, { sku: "sku-2", qty: 1, unitPrice: 50.00 }], total: 125.00
orderId: "ord-100", items: [{ sku: "sku-1", qty: 1 }, { sku: "sku-2", qty: 1 }]
orderId: "ord-100", items: [{ sku: "sku-1", qty: 1 }, { sku: "sku-2", qty: 1 }]
The customer picks the payment method on CheckoutScreen.
CheckoutScreen assigns orderId when checkout opens; it identifies the
order in every context and is the idempotency key for external calls.
Total and items come from CartSummary, never from the command.
external_system: "payment_gateway", timeout: "10s", retry: { max: 3, backoff: exponential }, idempotency_key: "orderId", gateway_result: "approved with authorizationId, or declined with reason"

external_system: "warehouse_inventory", timeout: "30s", retry: { max: 3, backoff: exponential }, idempotency_key: "orderId plus allocation attempt number", inventory_result: "allocated with shipmentId and warehouseId, or unavailable with missingSkus"
Re-issue AllocateShipment only when the replenished sku is one of the
missingSkus of the deferred order; the warehouse chooses where to allocate.
place order from a priced cart
evt Pricing.CartPriced { cartId: "c-100", customerId: "cust-7", items: [{ sku: "sku-1", qty: 1, unitPrice: 75.00 }, { sku: "sku-2", qty: 1, unitPrice: 50.00 }], total: 125.00 }
cmd PlaceOrder { orderId: "ord-100", cartId: "c-100", customerId: "cust-7", paymentMethodId: "pm-9" }

evt OrderPlaced { orderId: "ord-100", cartId: "c-100", customerId: "cust-7", paymentMethodId: "pm-9", items: [{ sku: "sku-1", qty: 1, unitPrice: 75.00 }, { sku: "sku-2", qty: 1, unitPrice: 50.00 }], total: 125.00 }
reject order when cart has no priced items
evt Pricing.CartPriced { cartId: "c-100", customerId: "cust-7", items: [], total: 0.00 }
cmd PlaceOrder { orderId: "ord-100", cartId: "c-100", customerId: "cust-7", paymentMethodId: "pm-9" }
order is confirmed after payment is authorized
order is cancelled after payment declines
authorize payment when the gateway approves the charge
decline payment when the gateway declines the charge
payment status shows an authorized payment
payment status shows a declined payment
paid order is ready to ship
evt Sales.OrderPlaced { orderId: "ord-100", items: [{ sku: "sku-1", qty: 1 }, { sku: "sku-2", qty: 1 }] }
rmo PaidOrdersToShip { orderId: "ord-100", items: [{ sku: "sku-1", qty: 1 }, { sku: "sku-2", qty: 1 }], status: "ready_to_ship" }
unpaid order is not ready to ship
evt Sales.OrderPlaced { orderId: "ord-100", items: [{ sku: "sku-1", qty: 1 }, { sku: "sku-2", qty: 1 }] }
rmo PaidOrdersToShip { orderId: "ord-100", items: [{ sku: "sku-1", qty: 1 }, { sku: "sku-2", qty: 1 }], status: "awaiting_payment" }
allocate shipment when inventory is available
evt Sales.OrderPlaced { orderId: "ord-100", items: [{ sku: "sku-1", qty: 1 }, { sku: "sku-2", qty: 1 }] }
cmd AllocateShipment { orderId: "ord-100", items: [{ sku: "sku-1", qty: 1 }, { sku: "sku-2", qty: 1 }] }
defer shipment when inventory is not available
evt Sales.OrderPlaced { orderId: "ord-100", items: [{ sku: "sku-1", qty: 1 }, { sku: "sku-2", qty: 1 }] }
cmd AllocateShipment { orderId: "ord-100", items: [{ sku: "sku-1", qty: 1 }, { sku: "sku-2", qty: 1 }] }
allocated shipment is queued for picking
rmo ShipmentQueue { shipmentId: "sh-55", orderId: "ord-100", warehouseId: "wh-1", status: "queued_for_picking" }
retry allocation when a missing sku is replenished
evt Sales.OrderPlaced { orderId: "ord-100", items: [{ sku: "sku-1", qty: 1 }, { sku: "sku-2", qty: 1 }] }
cmd AllocateShipment { orderId: "ord-100", items: [{ sku: "sku-1", qty: 1 }, { sku: "sku-2", qty: 1 }] }
keep waiting when an unrelated sku is replenished
ignore cancellation when order is already cancelled
confirm order after payment is authorized
ignore confirmation when order is already confirmed
